charge_port.notes: Lexus USA 2023 RZ 450e: CCS1 socket on all models (US).
Lexus Canada: CCS1 on 2023-2025 Lexus BEVs (Canada).

supercharger_access.notes: US: MY2023-25 RZ need a CCS to J3400 adapter for Tesla Superchargers; complimentary adapter via dealer from Nov 2025.
Canada: MY2023-25 need a CCS1 to J3400 adapter (Lexus Canada release, Nov 2025).

wheels.notes: US Luxury AWD: 20x8 front, 20x9.5 rear, P235/50VR20 / P255/45WR20. Per data/variants: Signature = US Premium (18 in standard, 20 in option), Luxury = US Luxury (20 in only).
